cases.expectation: January 9, 2027 shows holiday, payday, pay-period end 26 and leave-year end together; January 2026 still shows Jan 1/19 holidays, Jan 24 period end and Jan 30 payday.

description: Developer-only marker overlap fixture for T-CAL-MARK-01. The calendar-2026 store with every stored pay_date equal to its period end (display offset 0) and a 2027 holiday cache with one synthetic January 9, 2027 entry, so January 9 carries all four events: holiday, payday, pay-period end 26, leave-year end.

notes: Zero display payday offset is baked into the stored pay_date fields.
The synthetic holiday never leaves developer fixtures; production holiday data comes from offline generation or restored backups.
